lesson.title: 对数运算法则

en.title: Laws of Logarithms
en.description: Product, quotient and power laws; domains, logarithmic scales, change of base and data models.

lesson.description: 积、商与幂法则、定义域、对数标度、换底和数据模型。

concepts.title: 积、商与幂的对数法则

method.title: 第 1 步
method.body: 设 $M=c^u,N=c^v$；由指数法则得 $MN=c^{u+v}$、$M/N=c^{u-v}$、$M^P=c^{uP}$。

method.title: 第 2 步
method.body: 取以 $c$ 为底的对数，分别得到和、差与倍数。

pitfalls: 对数没有把和拆开的法则。
$\log_c(M^2)=2\log_c|M|$ 对 $M\ne0$ 成立；写成 $2\log_cM$ 还需 $M>0$。

en.title: Product, quotient and power laws

method.title: Step 1
method.body: Write $M=c^u,N=c^v$; exponent laws give $MN=c^{u+v}$, $M/N=c^{u-v}$ and $M^P=c^{uP}$.

method.title: Step 2
method.body: Take base-$c$ logarithms to obtain the sum, difference and multiple.

pitfalls: There is no logarithm law that separates a sum.

concepts.title: 展开对数并保留定义域
concepts.summary: 把乘、除、根式写成和、差与系数；每个新真数必须为正。

method.title: 第 1 步
method.body: 先检查原真数的正性，再把根式写成分数指数。

method.title: 第 2 步
method.body: 用积、商、幂法则逐层展开；若原式容许负因子，使用绝对值或明确正变量分支。

pitfalls: 不得把原式较大的定义域悄悄缩小。

en.title: Expand logarithms and preserve the domain
en.summary: Convert products, quotients and roots into sums, differences and coefficients; every new logarithmic argument must be positive.

method.title: Step 1
method.body: Check positivity in the original expression, then write roots as fractional powers.

method.title: Step 2
method.body: Apply the laws one layer at a time; use absolute values or explicitly state a positive-variable branch when the original permits negative factors.

pitfalls: Do not silently shrink the original domain.

concepts.title: 合并并精确求值
concepts.summary: 先把系数移入指数，再把同底对数合并，最后写成底数的幂。

method.title: 第 1 步
method.body: 保留括号前的负号：减去一组对数等于除以整组真数的积。

method.title: 第 2 步
method.body: 把最终真数写成 $c^r$，用 $\log_c(c^r)=r$；小数只在最后舍入。

pitfalls: 不同底数的对数不能直接用积商法则合并。

en.title: Combine and evaluate exactly
en.summary: Move coefficients into exponents, combine logarithms of the same base, then recognize a power of the base.

method.title: Step 1
method.body: Preserve a minus sign before brackets: subtracting a sum divides by the product of all its arguments.

method.title: Step 2
method.body: Write the final argument as $c^r$ and use $\log_c(c^r)=r$; round decimals only at the end.

pitfalls: The product and quotient laws combine logarithms only when their bases agree.

concepts.title: 化为一个对数及原始限制
concepts.summary: 合并后可以约因子，但限制由原式每个真数严格为正共同决定。

method.title: 第 1 步
method.body: 分别解所有原真数 $>0$，取交集。

method.title: 第 2 步
method.body: 用幂法则、积商法则合并，再因式分解约简，保留原限制。

pitfalls: 约去的因子不能使原来被排除的点重新有效。

en.title: A single logarithm and original restrictions
en.summary: Factors may cancel after combining; restrictions still come from the intersection of strict positivity conditions in the original.

method.title: Step 1
method.body: Solve every original argument $>0$ and intersect the solutions.

method.title: Step 2
method.body: Use the power, product and quotient laws, then factor and simplify while retaining the original restrictions.

pitfalls: Cancelling a factor does not restore an excluded value.

concepts.title: 分贝、pH 与对数比值
concepts.summary: 声强级 $\beta=10\log(I/I_0)$；$\mathrm{pH}=-\log[H^+]$。差值对应比值的对数。

method.title: 第 1 步
method.body: 对同一参考量作差：$\beta_2-\beta_1=10\log(I_2/I_1)$；浓度比为 $10^{\mathrm{pH}_1-\mathrm{pH}_2}$。

method.title: 第 2 步
method.body: 转为指数形式，检查比值无单位，原浓度或强度单位正确。电压增益题使用系数 $20$。

pitfalls: 教材使用的“响度倍数”在本节模型中指物理声强之比；不是人的主观感受倍数。

en.title: Decibels, pH and logarithmic ratios
en.summary: Sound level is $\beta=10\log(I/I_0)$ and $\mathrm{pH}=-\log[H^+]$. A difference of levels corresponds to a logarithm of a ratio.

method.title: Step 1
method.body: Subtract using the same reference: $\beta_2-\beta_1=10\log(I_2/I_1)$; the concentration ratio is $10^{\mathrm{pH}_1-\mathrm{pH}_2}$.

method.title: Step 2
method.body: Convert to exponential form; ratios are dimensionless while concentrations and intensities retain their units. Voltage gain uses a factor of $20$.

pitfalls: In this section the model interprets “times as loud” as a physical intensity ratio, not a ratio of perceived loudness.

concepts.title: 换底与恒等式

method.title: 第 1 步
method.body: 设 $u=\log_cx$，则 $c^u=x$。两边取以 $d$ 为底的对数得 $u\log_dc=\log_dx$。

method.title: 第 2 步
method.body: 因 $c\ne1$，$\log_dc\ne0$；相除得到换底式，并逐项核查恒等式分母。

pitfalls: 取对数真数 $p$ 可为 $1$，但含 $1/\log_qp$ 时必须排除 $p=1$。

en.title: Change of base and identities
en.summary: $\log_cx=\log_dx/\log_dc$ for $x>0$, $c,d>0$, with both bases different from $1$.

method.title: Step 1
method.body: Let $u=\log_cx$, so $c^u=x$. Taking base-$d$ logs gives $u\log_dc=\log_dx$.

method.title: Step 2
method.body: Since $c\ne1$, $\log_dc\ne0$. Divide to obtain the formula, and check every denominator in an identity.

pitfalls: An argument $p$ may equal $1$, but $1/\log_qp$ requires $p\ne1$.

concepts.title: 对数法则与图像变换
concepts.summary: 同一代数式在共同定义域上可相等，而函数的完整图像仍可能不同。

method.title: 第 1 步
method.body: 用法则在有效定义域内重写为基础对数函数的变换。

method.title: 第 2 步
method.body: 比较定义域、渐近线、截距和分支；例如 $\log x^2=2\log|x|$ 有左右两支。

pitfalls: $\log x^2$ 与 $2\log x$ 的定义域分别是 $x\ne0$ 与 $x>0$。

en.title: Logarithm laws and graph transformations
en.summary: Expressions may agree on their common domain while their complete function graphs differ.

method.title: Step 1
method.body: Rewrite as transformations of a parent logarithmic function within the valid domain.

method.title: Step 2
method.body: Compare domains, asymptotes, intercepts and branches; for example, $\log x^2=2\log|x|$ has two branches.

pitfalls: The domains of $\log x^2$ and $2\log x$ are $x\ne0$ and $x>0$, respectively.

concepts.title: 比较数据模型
concepts.summary: 按给定函数族拟合时，要说明准则，检查所有数据点与长期行为。

method.title: 第 1 步
method.body: 对给定参数形式求最小平方误差，并列出参数、有效域与单位。

method.title: 第 2 步
method.body: 比较残差总和及是否有合理的累计收入上限；不能声称近似拟合精确通过每个点。

pitfalls: 表中的有限观测值不能唯一证明某模型代表全部未来。

en.title: Compare models with data
en.summary: When fitting a prescribed function family, state a criterion, inspect all residuals and consider long-term behaviour.

method.title: Step 1
method.body: Minimize squared errors for the stated parameter form and report parameters, domain and units.

method.title: Step 2
method.body: Compare residual sums of squares and whether a cumulative revenue limit is reasonable; do not call an approximate fit exact.

pitfalls: A finite data table cannot establish that a model describes all future observations.

questions.prompt: (a) 证明 $\log(1000\times100)\ne(\log1000)(\log100)$。(b) 用计算器求下列表达式，保留四位小数：(i) $\log6+\log5$；(ii) $\log21$；(iii) $\log11+\log9$；(iv) $\log99$；(v) $\log7+\log3$；(vi) $\log30$。(c) 据此对正实数 $M,N$ 猜想 $\log M+\log N$ 的法则。(d) 用此法则把 $\log1000+\log100$ 写为一个对数。

steps.title: 第 5 步
steps.body: (c) 配对 (i,vi)、(ii,v)、(iii,iv)，猜想 $\log M+\log N=\log(MN)$，$M,N>0$。(d) 得 $\log(1000\times100)=\log100000$。

en.prompt: (a) Show that $\log(1000\times100)\ne(\log1000)(\log100)$. (b) Use a calculator to find each value to four decimal places: (i) $\log6+\log5$; (ii) $\log21$; (iii) $\log11+\log9$; (iv) $\log99$; (v) $\log7+\log3$; (vi) $\log30$. (c) Suggest a law for $\log M+\log N$ for positive real $M,N$. (d) Express $\log1000+\log100$ as a single logarithm.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: (a) The left side is $\log100000=5$; the right side is $3\times2=6$, so they differ.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: (c) The matching pairs (i,vi), (ii,v), (iii,iv) suggest $\log M+\log N=\log(MN)$, $M,N>0$. (d) Thus the single logarithm is $\log100000$.

en.prompt: (a) Show that $\log(1000/100)\ne\log1000/\log100$. (b) Evaluate to four decimal places: (i) $\log12$; (ii) $\log35-\log5$; (iii) $\log36$; (iv) $\log72-\log2$; (v) $\log48-\log4$; (vi) $\log7$. (c) Suggest a law for $\log M-\log N$, $M,N>0$. (d) Write $\log1000-\log100$ as a single logarithm.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: (a) The left side is $\log10=1$ and the right side is $3/2=1.5$.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: (c) The pairs suggest $\log M-\log N=\log(M/N)$ for $M,N>0$. (d) The result is $\log(1000/100)=\log10$.

questions.prompt: (a) 证明 $\log1000^2\ne(\log1000)^2$。(b) 求四位小数：(i) $3\log5$；(ii) $\log49$；(iii) $\log125$；(iv) $\log16$；(v) $4\log2$；(vi) $2\log7$。(c) 对正实数 $M$ 与任意实数 $P$，猜想 $P\log M$ 的法则。(d) 把 $2\log1000$ 写为没有系数的对数。

en.prompt: (a) Show that $\log1000^2\ne(\log1000)^2$. (b) Evaluate to four decimal places: (i) $3\log5$; (ii) $\log49$; (iii) $\log125$; (iv) $\log16$; (v) $4\log2$; (vi) $2\log7$. (c) Suggest a law for $P\log M$, where $M>0$ and $P$ is real. (d) Express $2\log1000$ as a logarithm without a coefficient.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: (c) The matching values suggest $P\log M=\log(M^P)$ for $M>0$. (d) $2\log1000=\log1000^2=\log1000000$.

questions.prompt: 常用对数的法则适用于一切正且不为 $1$ 的底数。不用科技求值：(a) $\log_6 18+\log_6 2$；(b) $\log_2 40-\log_2 5$；(c) $4\log_9 3$。

en.prompt: The laws also hold for any positive base other than $1$. Without technology evaluate (a) $\log_6 18+\log_6 2$; (b) $\log_2 40-\log_2 5$; (c) $4\log_9 3$.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: (c) $4\log_9 3=\log_9 3^4=\log_9 81=2$; all bases and arguments are valid.

questions.label: 反思与回应 4

questions.prompt: 指数法则为 $(c^x)(c^y)=c^{x+y}$、$c^x/c^y=c^{x-y}$（$c\ne0$）、$(c^x)^y=c^{xy}$。解释三条对数法则分别如何与它们相联系。

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: 在实数对数中取 $c>0,c\ne1$。设 $M=c^u,N=c^v$，于是 $\log_cM=u,\log_cN=v$。

steps.title: 第 4 步
steps.body: 幂的幂法则给 $M^P=c^{uP}$，所以 $\log_c(M^P)=uP=P\log_cM$。正底数保证任意实指数有效。

questions.answer: 对数是指数，乘、除、乘方分别对应指数相加、相减、相乘。

en.prompt: Explain how the three logarithm laws correspond to the exponent laws $(c^x)(c^y)=c^{x+y}$, $c^x/c^y=c^{x-y}$ ($c\ne0$), and $(c^x)^y=c^{xy}$.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: For real logarithms require $c>0,c\ne1$. Set $M=c^u,N=c^v$, so $\log_cM=u,\log_cN=v$.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: The power-of-a-power rule gives $M^P=c^{uP}$, hence $\log_c(M^P)=uP=P\log_cM$. Positive bases allow every real exponent.

en.answer: Logarithms are exponents: multiplying, dividing and raising to a power correspond to adding, subtracting and multiplying exponents.
en.label: Reflect and Respond 5

questions.prompt: 怎样只用积法则与幂法则证明对数的商法则？

en.label: Margin: prove the quotient law

questions.label: 旁注：证明商法则

questions.prompt: 把各式写成 $x,y,z$ 的单独对数：(a) $\log_5\frac{xy}{z}$；(b) $\log_7\sqrt[3]{x}$；(c) $\log_6\frac1{x^2}$；(d) $\log\frac{x^3}{y\sqrt z}$。

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: 按教材的正变量分支：(a) $\log_5(xy)-\log_5z=\log_5x+\log_5y-\log_5z$，$x,y,z>0$。原式更大的定义域为 $z\ne0,xy/z>0$；其通式是 $\log_5|x|+\log_5|y|-\log_5|z|$。

steps.title: 第 4 步
steps.body: (d) 正变量时：$\log x^3-\log y-\log z^{1/2}=3\log x-\log y-\frac12\log z$。原式要求 $z>0$ 且 $x,y$ 同号且非零；全域形式为 $3\log|x|-\log|y|-\frac12\log z$。

questions.answer: 正变量形式：(a) $\log_5x+\log_5y-\log_5z$；(b) $\frac13\log_7x$；(c) $-2\log_6x$；(d) $3\log x-\log y-\frac12\log z$。全域扩展见步骤。

en.prompt: Write each expression in terms of individual logarithms of $x,y,z$: (a) $\log_5\frac{xy}{z}$; (b) $\log_7\sqrt[3]{x}$; (c) $\log_6\frac1{x^2}$; (d) $\log\frac{x^3}{y\sqrt z}$.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: On the textbook positive-variable branch, (a) $\log_5(xy)-\log_5z=\log_5x+\log_5y-\log_5z$, $x,y,z>0$. The full original domain is $z\ne0,xy/z>0$; there the absolute-value form is $\log_5|x|+\log_5|y|-\log_5|z|$.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: (c) $1/x^2>0$ exactly when $x\ne0$. Thus $\log_6(1/x^2)=-\log_6x^2=-2\log_6|x|$. For $x>0$ this is the textbook form $-2\log_6x$.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: (d) For positive variables, $\log x^3-\log y-\log z^{1/2}=3\log x-\log y-\frac12\log z$. The full domain requires $z>0$ and nonzero $x,y$ of the same sign; there use $3\log|x|-\log|y|-\frac12\log z$.

en.answer: Positive-variable forms: (a) $\log_5x+\log_5y-\log_5z$; (b) $\frac13\log_7x$; (c) $-2\log_6x$; (d) $3\log x-\log y-\frac12\log z$. See steps for full-domain forms.
en.label: Textbook Example 1

questions.prompt: 将各式写成最简的一个对数，并说明变量限制：(a) $\log_7x^2+\log_7x-\frac{5\log_7x}{2}$；(b) $\log_5(2x-2)-\log_5(x^2+2x-3)$。

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: (a) 原式含 $\log_7x$，所以 $x>0$。合并为 $\log_7[x^2x/x^{5/2}]=\log_7x^{1/2}=\log_7\sqrt x$，亦为 $\frac12\log_7x$。

steps.title: 第 3 步
steps.body: 在此交集上 $\log_5\frac{2(x-1)}{(x+3)(x-1)}=\log_5\frac2{x+3}$。约分后仍保留 $x>1$。

en.prompt: Write each as a single logarithm in simplest form and state restrictions: (a) $\log_7x^2+\log_7x-\frac{5\log_7x}{2}$; (b) $\log_5(2x-2)-\log_5(x^2+2x-3)$.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: (a) The original contains $\log_7x$, so $x>0$. Combine to get $\log_7[x^2x/x^{5/2}]=\log_7x^{1/2}=\log_7\sqrt x$, also $\frac12\log_7x$.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: (b) $2x-2>0$ gives $x>1$; $(x+3)(x-1)>0$ gives $x<-3$ or $x>1$. Their intersection is $x>1$.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: On this intersection, $\log_5\frac{2(x-1)}{(x+3)(x-1)}=\log_5\frac2{x+3}$. Retain $x>1$ after cancellation.

en.label: Textbook Example 3

questions.label: 教材例题 3

questions.prompt: 例题 3(b) 的二次不等式 $x^2+2x-3>0$ 还可以怎样解？

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: 方法一：零点为 $-3,1$，抛物线开口向上，所以两零点外侧函数为正，即 $x<-3$ 或 $x>1$。

steps.title: 第 2 步
steps.body: 方法二：配方为 $(x+1)^2>4$，故 $|x+1|>2$，得到 $x<-3$ 或 $x>1$。再与另一个真数的 $x>1$ 取交集。

questions.answer: 图像法或配方法；二次式为正的范围 $(-\infty,-3)\cup(1,\infty)$，原对数式范围 $x>1$。

en.prompt: What other methods solve the quadratic inequality $x^2+2x-3>0$ in Example 3(b)?

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Method 1: the zeros are $-3,1$ and the parabola opens upward, so it is positive outside the zeros: $x<-3$ or $x>1$.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Method 2: completing the square gives $(x+1)^2>4$, hence $|x+1|>2$, so $x<-3$ or $x>1$. Intersect with the other argument restriction $x>1$.

en.answer: Use the graph or complete the square: the quadratic is positive on $(-\infty,-3)\cup(1,\infty)$; the original logarithmic expression requires $x>1$.
en.label: Margin: quadratic inequality

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: 这是一道拟合活动，并未指定必须经过哪些点。以下以全部 $19$ 个观测的平方残差和最小为统一准则；每个 $x$ 以周计，$y$ 以百万美元计。两族都不能精确通过每个四舍五入数据点。

steps.title: 第 2 步
steps.body: (1) 令 $A=20/\ln1.3$，则模型为 $A\ln(x-h)+k$。须 $h<1$ 才包含全部周数。固定 $h$ 时，令 $k=\frac1{19}\Sigma[y_i-A\ln(x_i-h)]$，使平方残差和对 $k$ 最小。

steps.title: 第 3 步
steps.body: 数值最小化余下的单变量平方残差和，得到 $h\approx0.597493$、$k\approx135.840049$。模型为 $y=20\log_{1.3}(x-0.5975)+135.8400$，定义域 $x>0.5975$；平方残差和约 $2670.923$，均方根误差约 $11.856$ 百万美元。

steps.title: 第 4 步
steps.body: (2) 写成 $y=C(0.74)^x+k$，其中 $C=-104(0.74)^{-h}<0$。设 $u_i=(0.74)^{x_i}$，用直线最小二乘 $C=\frac{\Sigma(u_i-\bar u)(y_i-\bar y)}{\Sigma(u_i-\bar u)^2}$，$k=\bar y-C\bar u$。

steps.title: 第 6 步
steps.body: (3) 指数模型误差较小，且 $x\to\infty$ 时累计收入趋向 $337.11$ 百万美元，符合票房增长趋缓的趋势。对数模型无限增长，在较晚周数上系统性高估。拟合不能保证对未知未来成立；本题比较只基于所给数据和合理趋势。

en.prompt: The table shows cumulative box-office receipts in millions of dollars for a popular new movie. At weeks $x=1,2,\ldots,19$, revenues are $70,144,191,229,256,275,291,304,313,320,325,328,330,332,334,335,335,336,337$. (1) Fit a logarithmic model of the form $y=20\log_{1.3}(x-h)+k$. (2) Fit an exponential model of the form $y=-104(0.74)^{x-h}+k$. (3) Compare the models and explain whether one is better.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: This fitting activity does not specify interpolation points. Use the same criterion for both families: minimize the sum of squared residuals over all $19$ observations. The units are weeks for $x$ and millions of dollars for $y$. Neither family passes exactly through every rounded data point.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: (1) Let $A=20/\ln1.3$, making the model $A\ln(x-h)+k$. Require $h<1$ to include all weeks. For fixed $h$, the minimizing intercept is $k=\frac1{19}\Sigma[y_i-A\ln(x_i-h)]$.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Numerically minimizing the remaining one-variable sum gives $h\approx0.597493$ and $k\approx135.840049$. The model is $y=20\log_{1.3}(x-0.5975)+135.8400$, with domain $x>0.5975$. Its squared-error sum is about $2670.923$ and its root mean squared error about $11.856$ million dollars.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: (2) Write $y=C(0.74)^x+k$, with $C=-104(0.74)^{-h}<0$. Let $u_i=(0.74)^{x_i}$ and use linear least squares: $C=\frac{\Sigma(u_i-\bar u)(y_i-\bar y)}{\Sigma(u_i-\bar u)^2}$, $k=\bar y-C\bar u$.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: The data give $C\approx-359.561174$ and $k\approx337.105969$. From $h=-\ln(-C/104)/\ln0.74$, $h\approx4.119802$, giving $y=-104(0.74)^{x-4.1198}+337.1060$. The squared-error sum is about $37.707$ and the root mean squared error about $1.409$ million dollars.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.body: (3) The exponential model has smaller error and approaches $337.11$ million dollars as $x\to\infty$, matching the observed leveling of cumulative revenue. The logarithmic model grows without bound and systematically overestimates later weeks. This comparison uses the given data and plausible trend; it does not establish a guaranteed future law.

en.answer: One explicit all-data least-squares answer: logarithmic $y=20\log_{1.3}(x-0.5975)+135.8400$; exponential $y=-104(0.74)^{x-4.1198}+337.1060$. The exponential model has smaller squared error and a plausible upper limit, so it fits better.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: (c) $\beta_{\mathrm{tractor}}-80=10\log63\approx17.9934$, so $\beta_{\mathrm{tractor}}\approx97.99$ dB. The intensity ratios are dimensionless.

exercises.prompt: Abdi 错误地说：“20 dB 的噪声是 10 dB 噪声的两倍响。”解释其推理错误。

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: 分贝是对数标度，不能把数值直接相除当作声强比。$20-10=10\log(I_{20}/I_{10})$。

steps.title: 第 2 步
steps.body: $\log(I_{20}/I_{10})=1$，故强度比为 $10$，不是 $2$。主观响度并不由本题的物理声强公式直接给出。

exercises.answer: 20 dB 对应的物理声强是 10 dB 的 $10$ 倍；不能用分贝值的比来求声强比。

en.prompt: Abdi incorrectly says, “A noise of $20$ dB is twice as loud as a noise of $10$ dB.” Explain the error.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Decibels form a logarithmic scale; dividing the level numbers does not give an intensity ratio. $20-10=10\log(I_{20}/I_{10})$.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: $\log(I_{20}/I_{10})=1$, so the intensity ratio is $10$, not $2$. Perceived loudness is not directly given by this physical intensity formula.

en.answer: The physical intensity at $20$ dB is $10$ times that at $10$ dB; a ratio of decibel numbers is not an intensity ratio.

exercises.prompt: 分贝也用于电子学的电流、电压比。放大器增益为 $G=20\log(V/V_i)$，其中 $V$ 为输出电压、$V_i$ 为输入电压。输入 $0.2$ V 时增益 $24$ dB，求输出电压，保留到 $0.1$ V。

en.prompt: Decibels are also used for current and voltage ratios. Amplifier gain is $G=20\log(V/V_i)$, where $V$ is output and $V_i$ input voltage. If gain is $24$ dB for input $0.2$ V, find the output to the nearest tenth of a volt.

steps.title: 第 3 步
steps.body: (c) $[H^+]_c=500\cdot10^{-6.1}$，所以 $\mathrm{pH}_c=-\log(500\cdot10^{-6.1})=6.1-\log500\approx3.4010$。均得到正浓度；更高浓度对应更低 pH。

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: (b) The concentration ratio is $10^{-4.5}/10^{-5.6}=10^{1.1}\approx12.5893$, about $12.6$ times.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: (c) $[H^+]_c=500\cdot10^{-6.1}$, so $\mathrm{pH}_c=-\log(500\cdot10^{-6.1})=6.1-\log500\approx3.4010$. Concentrations are positive; greater concentration gives lower pH.

exercises.prompt: 排气速度为 $3.1$ km/s 的火箭，速度变化可用齐奥尔科夫斯基方程 $\Delta v=\frac{3.1}{0.434}(\log m_0-\log m_f)$ 求出（km/s），$m_0,m_f$ 为燃烧前后总质量（kg）。若质量比 $m_0/m_f=1.06$，求速度变化，保留到 $0.01$ km/s。

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: 因两质量为正，用商法则：$\log m_0-\log m_f=\log(m_0/m_f)=\log1.06\approx0.025305865$。

steps.title: 第 2 步
steps.body: $\Delta v=(3.1/0.434)(0.025305865\ldots)\approx0.180756$ km/s，故为 $0.18$ km/s。质量比大于 $1$，所以变化为正。

en.prompt: For a rocket with exhaust velocity $3.1$ km/s, the Tsiolkovsky equation gives $\Delta v=\frac{3.1}{0.434}(\log m_0-\log m_f)$ in km/s, where $m_0,m_f$ are initial and final total masses in kg. If $m_0/m_f=1.06$, find the velocity change to the nearest hundredth of a kilometre per second.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Since both masses are positive, the quotient law gives $\log m_0-\log m_f=\log(m_0/m_f)=\log1.06\approx0.025305865$.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: $\Delta v=(3.1/0.434)(0.025305865\ldots)\approx0.180756$ km/s, giving $0.18$ km/s. The ratio exceeds $1$, so the change is positive.

exercises.prompt: 在同一坐标系画 $y=\log x^2$ 和 $y=2\log x$。(a) 图像有哪些相同和不同？(b) 为什么不完全相同？(c) 虽然两函数不相同，等式 $\log x^2=2\log x$ 在双方对数都有定义时成立。此等式的 $x$ 限制是什么？

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: 作图：$y=\log x^2=2\log|x|$，取点 $(\pm0.1,-2),(\pm1,0),(\pm10,2)$；$y=2\log x$ 只取这些点的正 $x$ 分支。两者有竖直渐近线 $x=0$。

steps.title: 第 2 步
steps.body: (a) 在 $x>0$ 完全重合且值域都是实数。第一幅图另有关于 $y$ 轴对称的负 $x$ 分支；第一函数零点为 $\pm1$，第二函数零点仅 $1$。

steps.title: 第 3 步
steps.body: (b) $x^2>0$ 给 $x\ne0$，所以 $\log x^2$ 定义域是 $(-\infty,0)\cup(0,\infty)$；$\log x$ 只在 $x>0$ 有定义。函数的定义域不同。

steps.title: 第 4 步
steps.body: (c) 等式需取共同定义域，即 $x>0$；在该域幂法则合法。

exercises.answer: (a) 正半轴上重合，$\log x^2$ 另有负半轴分支；(b) 定义域不同；(c) $x>0$。

en.prompt: Graph $y=\log x^2$ and $y=2\log x$ on the same grid. (a) How are the graphs alike and different? (b) Why are they not identical? (c) Although these are different functions, the equation $\log x^2=2\log x$ is true where both logarithms are defined. What is its restriction on $x$?

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Plot $y=\log x^2=2\log|x|$ using $(\pm0.1,-2),(\pm1,0),(\pm10,2)$. The function $y=2\log x$ contains only the positive-$x$ branch. Both have vertical asymptote $x=0$.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: (a) They coincide for $x>0$ and both have range all real numbers. The first also has a negative-$x$ branch reflected in the $y$ axis; its zeros are $\pm1$, while the second has only $x=1$.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: (b) $x^2>0$ gives $x\ne0$, so $\log x^2$ has domain $(-\infty,0)\cup(0,\infty)$, whereas $\log x$ requires $x>0$. The functions have different domains.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: (c) The equation uses the common domain $x>0$, on which the power law is valid.

en.answer: (a) Same positive branch; $\log x^2$ also has a negative branch. (b) Their domains differ. (c) $x>0$.

exercises.prompt: (a) 证明换底公式 $\log_cx=\frac{\log_dx}{\log_dc}$，$c,d$ 为正且不为 $1$ 的实数。(b) 取 $d=10$，用常用对数计算 $\log_2 9.5$，保留四位小数。(c) 地质学的 Krumbein $\varphi$ 标度用 $\varphi=-\log_2D$ 分类砂砾等天然沉积物粒径，$D$ 为直径（mm）。把公式写成常用对数形式。(d) 卵石的 $\varphi=-5.7$，中砂的 $\varphi=2$；卵石直径是中砂的多少倍？用 (c) 的两种公式分别求。

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: (a) 另需 $x>0$。令 $u=\log_cx$，即 $c^u=x$。取以 $d$ 为底的对数：$u\log_dc=\log_dx$。因 $c\ne1$，$\log_dc\ne0$，得 $u=\log_dx/\log_dc$。

steps.title: 第 3 步
steps.body: (c) 换底得 $\varphi=-\log D/\log2$，其中 $D>0$。这里对数中使用直径以 mm 表示的数值。

steps.title: 第 5 步
steps.body: 用常用对数：$\log D_p=5.7\log2$、$\log D_s=-2\log2$，相减得 $\log(D_p/D_s)=7.7\log2$。因此 $D_p/D_s=10^{7.7\log2}\approx207.9366$，结果一致。

en.prompt: (a) Prove $\log_cx=\frac{\log_dx}{\log_dc}$, where $c,d$ are positive real bases other than $1$. (b) Use $d=10$ and common logarithms to find $\log_2 9.5$ to four decimal places. (c) The Krumbein $\varphi$ scale classifies natural sediments by $\varphi=-\log_2D$, where diameter $D$ is in mm. Express the formula using common logarithms. (d) A pebble has $\varphi=-5.7$ and medium sand $\varphi=2$. How many times the sand's diameter is the pebble's diameter? Use both versions of the formula.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: (a) Also require $x>0$. Let $u=\log_cx$, so $c^u=x$. Taking base-$d$ logarithms gives $u\log_dc=\log_dx$. Since $c\ne1$, $\log_dc\ne0$; divide to obtain $u=\log_dx/\log_dc$.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: (c) Change base to get $\varphi=-\log D/\log2$, $D>0$. The logarithm uses the numerical diameter measured in mm.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Using common logarithms, $\log D_p=5.7\log2$ and $\log D_s=-2\log2$, so $\log(D_p/D_s)=7.7\log2$. Thus $D_p/D_s=10^{7.7\log2}\approx207.9366$, the same result.

en.answer: (a) Formula proved for $x>0$; (b) $3.2479$; (c) $\varphi=-\log D/\log2$; (d) about $208$ times.

exercises.prompt: 证明各恒等式：(a) $\log_{q^3}p^3=\log_qp$；(b) $\frac1{\log_p2}-\frac1{\log_q2}=\log_2\frac pq$；(c) $\frac1{\log_qp}+\frac1{\log_qp}=\frac1{\log_{q^2}p}$；(d) $\log_{1/q}p=\log_q\frac1p$。

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: (a) 限制 $p>0,q>0,q\ne1$。换底：$\log_{q^3}p^3=\frac{3\log p}{3\log q}=\frac{\log p}{\log q}=\log_qp$。$p=1$ 亦可。

steps.title: 第 2 步
steps.body: (b) 限制 $p,q>0,p,q\ne1$。$1/\log_p2=\log_2p$，$1/\log_q2=\log_2q$，故左边 $\log_2p-\log_2q=\log_2(p/q)$。两个分母非零，因为 $2\ne1$。

steps.title: 第 3 步
steps.body: (c) 限制 $p,q>0,p,q\ne1$。原题确有两个相同的项。左边为 $2\frac{\log q}{\log p}$；右边 $1/\log_{q^2}p=\frac{\log q^2}{\log p}=2\frac{\log q}{\log p}$。

steps.title: 第 4 步
steps.body: (d) 限制 $p>0,q>0,q\ne1$。$\log_{1/q}p=\frac{\log p}{\log(q^{-1})}=-\frac{\log p}{\log q}=\frac{\log(p^{-1})}{\log q}=\log_q(1/p)$。

exercises.answer: (a)–(d) 在步骤所列共同定义域上均成立。

en.prompt: Prove each identity: (a) $\log_{q^3}p^3=\log_qp$; (b) $\frac1{\log_p2}-\frac1{\log_q2}=\log_2\frac pq$; (c) $\frac1{\log_qp}+\frac1{\log_qp}=\frac1{\log_{q^2}p}$; (d) $\log_{1/q}p=\log_q\frac1p$.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: (a) Require $p>0,q>0,q\ne1$. Change base: $\log_{q^3}p^3=\frac{3\log p}{3\log q}=\frac{\log p}{\log q}=\log_qp$. The value $p=1$ is allowed.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: (b) Require $p,q>0,p,q\ne1$. The reciprocals are $1/\log_p2=\log_2p$ and $1/\log_q2=\log_2q$, so their difference is $\log_2(p/q)$. Both denominators are nonzero since $2\ne1$.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: (c) Require $p,q>0,p,q\ne1$. The two identical terms are as printed. The left side is $2\frac{\log q}{\log p}$; the right side is $1/\log_{q^2}p=\frac{\log q^2}{\log p}=2\frac{\log q}{\log p}$.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: (d) Require $p>0,q>0,q\ne1$. Then $\log_{1/q}p=\frac{\log p}{\log(q^{-1})}=-\frac{\log p}{\log q}=\frac{\log(p^{-1})}{\log q}=\log_q(1/p)$.

en.answer: (a)–(d) hold on the common domains stated in the steps.

exercises.prompt: 描述如何由 $y=\log x$ 的图像得到：(a) $y=\log x^3$；(b) $y=\log(x+2)^5$；(c) $y=\log(1/x)$；(d) $y=\log\frac1{\sqrt{x-6}}$。

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: (a) $x^3>0$ 要求 $x>0$；$y=3\log x$，所以竖直伸长为 $3$ 倍。

steps.title: 第 3 步
steps.body: (c) $1/x>0$ 要求 $x>0$；$y=-\log x$，所以关于 $x$ 轴反射。

steps.title: 第 4 步
steps.body: (d) 根式在分母且为正，所以 $x>6$。$y=-\frac12\log(x-6)$，所以向右平移 $6$，竖直缩为 $1/2$，关于 $x$ 轴反射。

exercises.answer: (a) 竖直伸长 $3$ 倍；(b) 左移 $2$、竖直伸长 $5$ 倍；(c) 关于 $x$ 轴反射；(d) 右移 $6$、竖直缩为 $1/2$、关于 $x$ 轴反射。

en.prompt: Describe how to obtain each graph from $y=\log x$: (a) $y=\log x^3$; (b) $y=\log(x+2)^5$; (c) $y=\log(1/x)$; (d) $y=\log\frac1{\sqrt{x-6}}$.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: (a) $x^3>0$ requires $x>0$; $y=3\log x$, so stretch vertically by a factor of $3$.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: (b) $(x+2)^5>0$ requires $x>-2$; $y=5\log(x+2)$, so translate left $2$ and stretch vertically by a factor of $5$.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: (c) $1/x>0$ requires $x>0$; $y=-\log x$, so reflect in the $x$ axis.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: (d) The positive root is in the denominator, so $x>6$. Since $y=-\frac12\log(x-6)$, translate right $6$, compress vertically by $1/2$, and reflect in the $x$ axis.

en.answer: (a) Vertical stretch by $3$; (b) left $2$, vertical stretch by $5$; (c) reflection in the $x$ axis; (d) right $6$, vertical compression by $1/2$, reflection in the $x$ axis.

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: 角度以弧度给出；$\sin(\pi/4)=\sin(3\pi/4)=\sqrt2/2>0$，所以两个对数均有定义。

en.prompt: Evaluate $\log_2(\sin\frac\pi4)+\log_2(\sin\frac{3\pi}4)$.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: The angles are in radians; $\sin(\pi/4)=\sin(3\pi/4)=\sqrt2/2>0$, so both logarithms are defined.

exercises.prompt: (a) 等差数列的和 $\log2+\log4+\log8+\log16+\log32$ 的公差 $d$ 是什么？(b) 将此和表示为公差的倍数。

en.prompt: (a) What is the common difference $d$ in the arithmetic series $\log2+\log4+\log8+\log16+\log32$? (b) Express its sum as a multiple of the common difference.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: (a) $\log4-\log2=\log(4/2)=\log2$; every subsequent ratio is also $2$, hence $d=\log2$.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: (b) The terms are $d,2d,3d,4d,5d$ and their sum is $(1+2+3+4+5)d=15d$. Equivalently their arguments multiply to $2^{15}$, whose log is $15\log2$.

exercises.prompt: 为三条对数法则分别复制所示 Frayer 模板，在相应位置写出法则名称、代数表示、文字描述、例子与常见错误。

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: 积法则：代数式 $\log_c(MN)=\log_cM+\log_cN$；文字：积的对数等于各因数对数之和。例：$\log_2(4\cdot8)=2+3=5$。错误：误写 $\log_c(M+N)=\log_cM+\log_cN$。条件为 $M,N>0,c>0,c\ne1$。

steps.title: 第 2 步
steps.body: 商法则：$\log_c(M/N)=\log_cM-\log_cN$；文字：商的对数等于被除数对数减除数对数。例：$\log_3(81/3)=4-1=3$。错误：用两个对数相除或颠倒相减顺序。条件同上。

steps.title: 第 3 步
steps.body: 幂法则：$\log_c(M^P)=P\log_cM$；文字：幂的对数等于指数乘底数的对数。例：$\log_5(25^3)=3\log_525=6$。错误：误把 $(\log_cM)^P$ 写为 $P\log_cM$，或对负 $M$ 不检查定义域。条件为 $M>0,c>0,c\ne1,P\in\mathbb R$。

exercises.answer: 三个完成示例分别见步骤；模板可用同样五个栏目组织。

en.prompt: Copy the Frayer template for each logarithm law. Give the name, algebraic representation, written description, example and common errors in the appropriate spaces.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Product law: $\log_c(MN)=\log_cM+\log_cN$. Description: the logarithm of a product is the sum of the logarithms. Example: $\log_2(4\cdot8)=2+3=5$. Error: claiming $\log_c(M+N)=\log_cM+\log_cN$. Conditions: $M,N>0,c>0,c\ne1$.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Quotient law: $\log_c(M/N)=\log_cM-\log_cN$. Description: the logarithm of a quotient is the logarithm of the dividend minus that of the divisor. Example: $\log_3(81/3)=4-1=3$. Errors: dividing the logarithms or reversing the subtraction. The same positivity and base conditions apply.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Power law: $\log_c(M^P)=P\log_cM$. Description: the logarithm of a power is its exponent times the logarithm of the base. Example: $\log_5(25^3)=3\log_525=6$. Errors: replacing $(\log_cM)^P$ by $P\log_cM$, or ignoring the domain when $M$ is negative. Conditions: $M>0,c>0,c\ne1,P\in\mathbb R$.

en.answer: The steps give a completed model for each law, organized into the template's five requested fields.
